Jharkhand News: jharkhand ki bari khabren | Asian Games | SIR in Jharkhand | CM Hemant | Weather News
Jharkhand ke mukhyamantri hemant soren ne kangres prabhari ke.raju se shishtachar mulakat ki... rajy men chal rahe vikas yojnaon ki charcha ke sath vartaman rajnitik paristhitiyon par batchit ki gaee
Jamtara men saibar apradh ke khilaph pulis ko bari saphalta hath lagi hai... alag-alag thana kshetron men chhapemari kar tin shatir saibar apradhiyon ko giraphtar kiya hai... giraphtar aaropiyon ke pas se 8 lakh 13 hajar kaish, 8 mobail phon aur 6 sim kard baramad kie gae hain...
